atAGlance: Nem nướng cuốn is fresh rolls with grilled pork sausage, usually with nem nướng, herbs, pickles, rice paper, and a thick Nha Trang-style peanut-garlic dip.
whatItIs: Nem nướng cuốn is grilled pork sausage wrapped with rice paper, herbs, cucumber, pickles, noodles, and a thick peanut-garlic dip. It is smoky, crunchy, fresh, and rich at once.
howToEnjoy: Build each roll with nem nướng, herbs, crunch, and noodles, then dip into the thick peanut-garlic dip. Use less dip at first; it can be sweet and rich.
howLocalsOrder: Order nem nướng cuốn when you want the roll-it-yourself version of grilled pork sausage. Ask for extra rice paper, no peanuts, or no chili before the platter arrives.
worthKnowing: Nha Trang-style nem nướng is famous for the dip and the crunchy bits inside the roll, not just the pork sausage.
